purpose: Original specimen-specific multi-propeller, cooling, engine-chart and altitude performance evidence. Source observations only: never silently modifies the simulator physics or treats table cells as independent flight tests.

document_lineage.note: 68 scalar table rows on ONE P-47B airframe in two related tests, with different propellers, cooling, CG and an IAS/TAS heading contradiction.
February 5-prop comparison and April sway-brace comparison are separate experiments on 41-13635: do not treat as independent airframes; verify any different propeller nomenclature.
16 speed/climb anchors and four already-indexed direct CAS stall points belong to one Navy production-inspection trial; no stall duplicate.
Production vs special ETC/wheel-door/MW50/seals all vary; not independent flight hardware replications.
Power and performance observations supplement ALREADY indexed nine exact-weight IAS stalls, all Eng-47-1749-A; power from manufacturer engine chart.

calibration_reviews.finding: Climb table prints IAS 185–255mph but footnote explicitly says same speeds as December report, whose table prints True Speed. Preserve raw labels; likely January heading typo, not verified CAS.
calibration_reviews.next: Inspect original scan and original footnote with source identity before assigning speeds to the simulator.

calibration_reviews.finding: Flugbericht Nr1 PDF page 4 plots Fahrtmesserkorrektur with and without compressibility. Original axis/range must be digitized, and there is no evidence of low-speed stall coverage.
calibration_reviews.next: Digitize calibration graph original pixels with measured-speed domain and sign; never extend unmeasured graph to stall.
